title: KeyInfo reference ownership and final release

scope.rationale: sqlite3KeyInfoRef/Unref and the KeyInfo nRef/db owner fields are the complete intrusive reference contract used by P4_KEYINFO and unpacked records. Increment, decrement and final connection-aware free cannot be split.
excluded_responsibilities: P4 dispatch beyond the KeyInfo branch

external_source_responsibilities: Caller holds the connection mutex while references are mutable
dependencies.caller_closure: Both active reference functions and their exact count/database owner fields are assigned, including nullable no-op and final free. Allocation/population and P4 dispatch are follow-on units.

inputs: nullable KeyInfo pointer with positive nRef and nonnull db when present
outputs: same pointer with incremented count, decremented live count, or final connection-aware free
contracts.ownership: Every ref call creates one shared ownership claim; every unref consumes one. Transition 1->0 returns the entire KeyInfo allocation to its owning connection allocator.
contracts.state_and_results: Null ref returns null; null unref is a no-op. Ref returns pointer identity unchanged.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds connection mutex. No callback or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No allocation and no OOM path. Positive-count assertions reject underflow/use-after-final-release.

representation_differences: No semantic representation difference; u32 nRef and Sqlite3 owner pointer use verified extern fields.

oracle.protocol: The shared worker allocates one exact-size KeyInfo, performs 1->2 ref, 2->1 unref, 1->0 final release, and nullable ref/unref. C and Zig compare pointer identity, counts, owner identity and live/freed tracking in a 366-observation trace.
internal_observations: ref return pointer identity and count
oracle.normalization: Pointer addresses normalize to same-pointer/live identity. Counts and null transitions are exact.

assurance.oom: No allocation in assigned functions; final release uses previously validated connection allocator.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O/callback; mutex integration remains caller obligation.
assurance.malformed_input: Assertions enforce nonnull db and positive count for live objects.
assurance.continuation: Object remains usable after nonfinal unref and becomes inaccessible after final unref; worker tracks owner accordingly.
assurance.performance: Constant-time increment/decrement and one final free.

integration.production_owner: src/core/internal/vdbe_aux.zig temporary source-corresponding KeyInfo lifecycle used by the VDBE closure
integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker uses exact KeyInfo/Sqlite3 allocation and owner fields; P4_KEYINFO dispatch is not yet connected.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Integrate into P4 and record owners, then relocate to the final select/key-info module if needed.

independent_review.notes: Requires P4/record integration, assurance closure, and independent review.
